_readme: Every external source this project has taken content from, in one place.
This is an INDEX, not a copy. The detail for each family stays in the
registry that importer already owns -- importers/sources.json,
`config` below points at it. Copying those entries here would guarantee the
two drift, and a source registry that lies is worse than none.
probe    how to tell, cheaply, whether the source has changed since we
last looked. tools/check_sources.py implements each kind.
feeds    what in dge/data (or which published branch) came from it.
importer the workflow that re-imports it. Blank means no importer exists
yet and a change is a note for a human, not a job to run.
rights   the licence position in one line. The long form lives in the
A source with `imported: false` is one we have read, cited or evaluated but
never ingested. It is here so that the question 'where did this come from,
and did we check it?' has an answer for every site the project has touched.

sources.title: GRETIL — Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages
sources.cadence: quarterly is plenty; GRETIL grows slowly
